newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco 9-mo net earnings fall 39 pct from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Codelco 9-mo net earnings fall 39 pct from 1995.

text.p: Chile's state owned copper company Codelco reported nine month net profits of $832.7 million, down 39 percent on the same period last year due to lower copper and molybdenum prices.

"The most significant factor which explains these results is the fall in copper prices which averaged $1.33 a pound in the first nine months of last year compared with $1.06 this year," Mariano Neira, information and control manager told a news conference with CEO Marcos Lima.
